Here are the visual differences between the original (Image 1) and the clone (Image 2):

**Header & Sub-header Text:**
*   **Subtitle:** Image 1 says "1 companies identified" (plural). Image 2 says "1 company identified" (singular).
*   **Table Header:** Image 1 says "VISITOR 11". Image 2 says "VISITOR".

**Sidebar & Navigation:**
*   **Active State:** In Image 1, the "Visitors" menu item has a light yellow background highlight. In Image 2, it does not have this background highlight (only the text/icon color is active).
*   **Footer:** The "Sign out" link in the bottom left is fully visible in Image 1. In Image 2, it is partially obscured by a black circular tooltip/element containing the letter "N".

**Table Data (Content):**
The table rows contain completely different data:
*   **Row 1:** Image 1 shows "Alibaba (US) Technology Co., Ltd." (Company type). Image 2 shows "jane.doe@example.com" (Social type).
*   **Row 2:** Image 1 shows "marcus.smith@acmecorp.com". Image 2 shows "Acme Corp".
*   **Row 3:** Image 1 shows "jane.doe@example.com". Image 2 shows "sarah.chen@gmail.com".

**Table Visuals (Status & Badges):**
*   **Status Badges:** All status badges in Image 1 are grey ("inactive"). In Image 2, the first two are yellow ("active") and only the last one is grey ("inactive").
*   **Type Badges:** 
    *   Row 1 in Image 2 uses a "Social" badge (cyan), whereas the equivalent position in Image 1 is "Company" (yellow).
    *   Row 3 in Image 2 uses a "Search" badge (cyan), whereas Image 1 uses "Direct".
*   **Confidence Scores:** The percentages differ (e.g., Image 2 shows 92% for the last row, while Image 1 shows 90%).
*   **Timestamps:** The "Last Active" times are different (Image 2 uses "4 min ago", Image 1 uses "13 hr ago" and "1d ago").

**UI Components:**
*   **Dropdowns:** The "All Confidence" dropdown in Image 2 appears to have truncated text ("All Confidenc"), whereas Image 1 displays the full text.
